# Module `ldp.a11y`

> Accessibility: settings broadcast (high contrast, reduced motion, text scale, keyboard access features), a screen-reader event bus, and magnifier control. Assistive technology subscribes with the `a11y_control` scope; content providers announce with a11y_provider.

Version range **1–1** · 2 interfaces · 7 requests · 1 events · 2 enums · 1 bitsets.

## Interfaces

### `ldp.a11y.accessibility`

Accessibility settings and assistive technology entry point. Settings events are broadcast to every bound client so toolkits can restyle immediately.

*global (registry-advertised)*

#### Requests

| Opcode | Name | Since | Reply | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `get_provider` | 1 | — | `id: new_id<a11y_provider>` |
| 2 | `set_magnifier` | 1 | — | `enabled: bool`, `follow: enum<magnifier_follow>`, `scale_q8: uint32` |
| 3 | `announce` | 1 | — | `text: string`, `priority: enum<announce_priority>` |

#### Events

| Opcode | Name | Since | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|
| 1 | `settings` | 1 | `enabled: bitset<a11y_settings>`, `text_scale_q8: uint32`, `cursor_size: uint32` |

### `ldp.a11y.a11y_provider`

Per-client semantic announcer. Events from here reach subscribed assistive technologies in order with focus attribution. Providers must keep announcements in sync with their visible UI state.

#### Requests

| Opcode | Name | Since | Reply | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `announce` | 1 | — | `text: string`, `priority: enum<announce_priority>` |
| 2 | `focus_changed` | 1 | — | `surface: object<ldp.core.surface>`, `role: string`, `label: string` |
| 3 | `caret_moved` | 1 | — | `surface: object<ldp.core.surface>`, `x: int32`, `y: int32` |
| 4 | `state_changed` | 1 | — | `surface: object<ldp.core.surface>`, `state: string`, `value: string` |

* `focus_changed.role` — e.g. 'button', 'text_field', 'checkbox'.
* `state_changed.state` — State name.
* `state_changed.value` — State value.
